output.content:
**Glucose comparison, CHO-004-R02 minus CHO-004-R01, at exactly matched elapsed sample times (from the Northfield Biologics · October runs delivery):**

- **Mean signed difference: −0.239 g/L** across 11 matched samples (elapsed 0.0 h to 142.0 h), meaning CHO-004-R02 ran slightly lower on glucose than CHO-004-R01 on average.
- **Largest absolute difference: 0.944 g/L at 19.5 h elapsed**, where CHO-004-R01 read 7.133 g/L and CHO-004-R02 read 6.189 g/L — the largest divergence of the paired times, with R02 lower by 0.944 g/L.
- **Batches compared: CHO-004-R01** (12 glucose samples, 0.0–164.0 h) and **CHO-004-R02** (11 glucose samples, 0.0–142.0 h). One CHO-004-R01 sample at 164.0 h had no exact-time counterpart in CHO-004-R02, so 11 of 12 possible pairs (91.7%) were matched; no interpolation or averaging was used.

**Provisional status:** these values come from the Northfield Biologics · October runs CMO delivery, which is **still in review and not yet verified** — the values were read from the delivery files but have not been checked by a reviewer, and 55 open verification checks are pending on that delivery. Treat the figures above as unreviewed until the delivery is approved; the comparison itself is descriptive only (no significance test, since successive samples within one run are not independent).
